captures.command: ssh -oBatchMode=yes -oConnectTimeout=5 trappserv.er 'printf "capturedAt="; date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; printf "hostName="; hostname; for f in /sys/devices/platform/coretemp.0/hwmon/hwmon2/name /sys/devices/platform/coretemp.0/hwmon/hwmon2/temp1_label /sys/devices/platform/coretemp.0/hwmon/hwmon2/temp1_input; do printf "%s=" "$f"; cat "$f"; done; printf "api="; curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:3004/api/telemetry/cpu-temperature; printf "containerEnvRoot="; docker exec aquarium-homepage printenv REEF_CPU_HWMON_ROOT; printf "containerMounts="; docker inspect --format "{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination}}{{end}}" aquarium-homepage; printf "containerImage="; docker inspect --format "{{.Image}}" aquarium-homepage; for f in /sys/devices/platform/coretemp.0/hwmon/hwmon2/name /sys/devices/platform/coretemp.0/hwmon/hwmon2/temp1_label /sys/devices/platform/coretemp.0/hwmon/hwmon2/temp1_input /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon2/name /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon2/temp1_label /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon2/temp1_input; do printf "container:%s=" "$f"; docker exec aquarium-homepage cat "$f"; done'

captures.method: Current local src/server/cpu-temperature.ts transformed in memory by Jiti 2.7.0 and streamed through SSH stdin to the app container Node 24 process

interpretation: The 40°C host/container sample and the 49°C direct-reader sample were taken 10 seconds apart and reflect changing live telemetry. The API request and direct-reader invocation are separate processes: only the direct-reader invocation is pinned to the current source in source-pins.json.
